description: One interactive session doing booking and RAG turns at a human pace, plus continuous re-ingestion of the clinic policies source. The booking steps are the read-only turns of the M3-16 conversation corpus (availability.list, patients.find) and one booking that is prepared and then rejected by the harness, never confirmed, so a 7-day run does not use up the clinic's slots. The RAG steps ask about the clinic policies in examples/reference-apps/clinic-booking/package/documentation/policies (en and it).

steps.text: How far ahead can an appointment be booked?
Entro quando si può annullare un appuntamento?
What are the possible reasons for cancelling an appointment?
Show me the free appointments with Dr Verdi over the next 7 days
How long does a booking wait for the confirmation?
